subject.title: docs: default agent validation to remote runners

question: Should OpenClaw make Crabbox/Testbox the default agent validation path and accept this sanitized direct-AWS bootstrap as the boundary for untrusted PR code after the mechanical blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR changes maintainer agent workflow and defines how untrusted code is executed away from credentialed Testbox runners; automation can fix the narrow defects but cannot choose the permanent security policy.

options.title: Fix then accept
options.body: Fix the Corepack-cache verification and docs map, then merge the remote-first policy as the maintained validation path.

options.title: Keep local fallback default
options.body: Keep the new safety guidance but avoid making all agent validation remote-first until operator workflow tradeoffs are settled.

options.title: Pause for security design
options.body: Move the untrusted AWS bootstrap boundary into a separate security-reviewed design if maintainers want stronger bootstrap or artifact verification first.

recommendation.title: Fix then accept
recommendation.body: Fix the Corepack-cache verification and docs map, then merge the remote-first policy as the maintained validation path.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the recent Testbox/docs area contributor and this PR's author for the maintainer workflow policy.
